market_logic.absorption_event: aggression that fails to achieve its own prior-reference displacement is an event anchor, not a direction signal
market_logic.disproof: a completed close extending beyond the absorbed auction extreme invalidates the pending reversal thesis
market_logic.downstream: after opposite context creation, pool formation, sweep, response, stop, objective, delayed entry, fees and 3% current-NAV risk remain inherited
market_logic.independent_structure: reversal becomes tradable only after a later completed lower-timeframe auction closes through prior structure; the anchor bar cannot self-confirm

selection_rule: fixed ex-ante priority among eligible variants passing the existing complete first-week gate; only the unchanged selected configuration may open both sealed weeks
